name: watchdog
description: avr-libc's watchdog: the WDT interrupt at 32 ms waking the part from power-down four times (about 130 ms), then wdt_enable(WDTO_60MS) kicked by wdt_reset() for 100 ms and left to time out 64 ms after the last kick, twice. A boot count in .noinit survives each watchdog reset; MCUSR reads PORF at power-on and WDRF after a watchdog reset.

expect.equals:
boot 1 mcusr 1
woken by the watchdog 4 times
kicked for 100 ms, now hanging

expect.contains:
boot 1 mcusr 1
woken by the watchdog 4 times
kicked for 100 ms, now hanging
boot 2 mcusr 8

expect.equals:
boot 1 mcusr 1
woken by the watchdog 4 times
kicked for 100 ms, now hanging
boot 2 mcusr 8
kicked for 100 ms, now hanging

expect.contains:
boot 1 mcusr 1
woken by the watchdog 4 times
kicked for 100 ms, now hanging
boot 2 mcusr 8
kicked for 100 ms, now hanging
boot 3 mcusr 8
done
